records.object: Charge carriers in the studied monolayers
records.quote: In this work, using a combination of density functional theory and semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory, we have studied the effect of electron-phonon coupling in monolayers of ZrS2, BiI3 and PbI2.
context_quotes: Our results show that in these ionic materials charge carriers are primarily scattered by the optical modes that strongly couple with them.

records.subject: Neglect of optical-mode contributions to electron–phonon coupling
records.object: Relaxation-time overestimation by about two orders of magnitude
records.quote: From our study it is conclusively shown that neglecting the contributions of optical modes to electron-phonon coupling in these low-dimensional ionic solids, as is usually done in the computation of relaxation time from deformation theory, results in severe overestimation of the relaxation time.
context_quotes: In particular, neglecting the scattering of the optical phonons results in about two orders of magnitude overestimation of relaxation times in these materials.
modality_evidence: In this work, using a combination of density functional theory and semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory, we have studied the effect of electron-phonon coupling in monolayers of ZrS2, BiI3 and PbI2.

From our study it is conclusively shown that neglecting the contributions of optical modes to electron-phonon coupling in these low-dimensional ionic solids, as is usually done in the computation of relaxation time from deformation theory, results in severe overestimation of the relaxation time.
